https://github.com/Stellarium/stellarium-skycultures/tree/106475b3b67488108cd5a346a737f3df42b3c7ad/chinese
Adaptation: selected 28 principal mansion asterisms, Chinese name for Star filled as 星宿; grouping and order added. This adapted line dataset remains CC BY-SA. No historical uniqueness is asserted.
